# A lookup without a sample fails and keeps its input

<!-- Generated by tests/e2e. Regenerate with ATLAS_E2E_UPDATE=1; review every change. -->

## 1. Look up a coordinate with no sample

SDK `GET /dataset` with <operator key>

→ **200**
```json
{
  "id": "<id-1>",
  "writing_release": "0.1.0"
}
```

SDK `POST /plugins/elevation/operations` with <operator key>
```json
{
  "dataset_id": "<id-1>",
  "submission_id": "<submission>",
  "capability": "elevation.lookup",
  "input": {
    "latitude": 41,
    "longitude": -71
  }
}
```

→ **202** · Location `/plugins/elevation/operations/<id-2>`
```json
{
  "capability": "elevation.lookup",
  "created_at": "<time>",
  "dataset_id": "<id-1>",
  "error": null,
  "id": "<id-2>",
  "input": {
    "latitude": 41,
    "longitude": -71
  },
  "output": null,
  "plugin_id": "elevation",
  "plugin_release": "1.0.0",
  "status": "pending",
  "submission_id": "<submission>"
}
```

Observed outcome:
```json
{
  "status": "failed",
  "output": {
    "latitude": 41,
    "longitude": -71
  },
  "error": "No elevation sample exists at this coordinate."
}
```
